newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbia to fund wheat sowing via forward contracts.
newsitem.headline: Serbia to fund wheat sowing via forward contracts.

text.p: Serbia's government will largely finance the 1997 wheat sowing through an issue of wheat selling forward contracts, the Belgrade daily Politika reported on Thursday.

"Serbian Commodity Reserve Agency will finance advanced purchase of up to 1.2 million tonnes of the 1997 wheat crop by issuing wheat selling forward contracts," Politika quoted a government statement as saying.
The Commodity Reserve Agency will start selling its new issue of 60-day contracts at the Belgrade bourse on October 3, Politika said.
Those securities will have a total of 1,007,100 tonnes of wheat as collateral.
Another 192,900 tonnes of wheat will be financed through barter arrangements, with farmers paid in kind -- in wheat seed, fertilisers and diesel, the paper said.
The government gave no further details about the price of wheat to be sold through these contracts.
